edits.text: Keep a noun or proper name together with immediately following post‑nominal material that completes its identification — specifically: parenthetical measurements/units (parentheses), immediate 'of' prepositional complements, appositives separated by commas, or an immediately following relative or clausal identifier; treat such adjacent material as a single unit for cutting.

As a fallback, prefer a cut after a clear clause boundary or punctuation over a cut that separates a noun or proper name from immediately following essential post‑nominal material (parenthetical measurements/units, immediate "of" complements, appositives, or adjacent relative/clausal identifiers).
